scope: CPU/local HTTP tests only; no physical model or GPU attestation

result.output:
usage: client.py [-h] --endpoint ENDPOINT --manifest MANIFEST --output OUTPUT
                 --model MODEL [--timeout TIMEOUT] [--deadline DEADLINE]
                 [--max-response-bytes MAX_RESPONSE_BYTES]
                 [--max-tokens MAX_TOKENS] [--max-image-bytes MAX_IMAGE_BYTES]
                 [--max-image-pixels MAX_IMAGE_PIXELS]

Bounded loopback multimodal qualification; never executes model output.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --endpoint ENDPOINT   HTTP origin at literal 127.0.0.1 or [::1]; no path,
                        auth, or redirects (default: None)
  --manifest MANIFEST   Existing frozen version-1 public cases JSON (relative
                        PNG paths and exact SHA-256) (default: None)
  --output OUTPUT       NEW exclusive output directory; parent must already
                        exist without symlinks (default: None)
  --model MODEL         Explicit server model ID/alias; recorded, not attested
                        (default: None)
  --timeout TIMEOUT     Absolute time budget in seconds per HTTP exchange,
                        including trickle traffic (max 3600) (default: 30)
  --deadline DEADLINE   Shared run budget in seconds from argument parsing; no
                        new network work after expiry (max 86400) (default:
                        300)
  --max-response-bytes MAX_RESPONSE_BYTES
                        Maximum decoded HTTP entity-body bytes retained per
                        exchange (max 16777216) (default: 1048576)
  --max-tokens MAX_TOKENS
                        Explicit completion budget; use 1 for a separate
                        first-token control (max 32768) (default: 32)
  --max-image-bytes MAX_IMAGE_BYTES
                        Maximum bytes per PNG (max 16777216) (default:
                        4194304)
  --max-image-pixels MAX_IMAGE_PIXELS
                        Maximum width*height per PNG (max 16777216) (default:
                        1048576)
